_about: The Arcade on drzahirhasan.com. One entry per game; the pages are rebuilt from this file by scripts/build-site.mjs. 'books' are catalogue slugs shown beside the game and can be changed freely (a slug that is not in the catalogue is skipped). 'best' says where the game keeps its score in the player's browser.
houseLine: A hidden room appears inside a boy's favourite game, with a message from someone his family says is dead.

games.title: Pod Breakers
games.tagline: Smash the alien pods before they hatch and save the last shield on Earth.
games.about: Alien pods are crashing down around Earth's last shield generator. Smash each pod before it hatches, blast the crawlers, jellies and charging beasts that get out, build turrets and call in an Orbital Strike. Unlock weapons, zones and a whole Xenodex of aliens.
games.readLine: More trouble from the sky, on the page.

games.title: Earthfall Command: Last Orbit
games.tagline: Command Earth's last orbital defence network against three alien factions.
games.about: Command Earth's last orbital defense network against three alien factions. Ten missions over a turning 3D Earth, six regions that each matter, two carrier bosses and three endings.
games.readLine: An orbital tether, and a mind that governs the Earth.

games.title: Brinkball
games.tagline: Shove, dash and bonk your rivals off a crumbling floating arena.
games.about: Dash, charge and bonk your rivals off a crumbling floating arena. The more hits they take, the further they fly. Climb from Bronze to Legend against CPU rivals, or settle it with a friend on the same keyboard or tablet.

games.title: Infinite Loot Goblin
games.tagline: Your goblin fights on his own. You manage the loot. If the bag overflows, you explode.
games.about: Your goblin runs and fights on his own. You manage the loot. A chest drops every three seconds, the legendaries break the game, and if your bag overflows, you explode.
games.readLine: Dragons, thrones and treasure with a higher price.

games.title: Magnetic Chaos: Keep the Sphere
games.tagline: Steer a gravity well through hundreds of charged fragments. How long can you last?
games.about: Steer a gravity well through hundreds of charged fragments. Same charge repels, opposite charge destroys the Spark. Then time slows, your polarity flips and a black hole opens. How long can you last?

games.title: Cinch
games.tagline: Drag the comet. Close a loop. Burst the cluster.
games.about: Hold to fly. Your lasers lock onto the fire-rocks falling toward Earth; lasso them, close the loop, and burst the cluster.

games.title: Lineburst
games.tagline: Fit the pieces. Burst the lines. A mean little 8×8 puzzle.
games.about: Draft five shapes, fit them onto the 8×8 board, and burst the lines. The tray is your kit, so choose carefully.
